examples.title: Exploration of Gemfibrozil as a Treatment for AUD

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Gemfibrozil low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M]. Due to chemical, pharmacological, and clinical similarities between Gemfibrozil and another drug called clofibrate, harmful findings from two large studies on clofibrate may also apply to Gemfibrozil [3]. In the first of those studies, called the Coronary Drug Project, researchers followed 1,000 subjects who had previously experienced a myocardial infarction, which is a heart attack [3].
